Super Rare.name: Adhesion Trap Hole
Super Rare.desc: When your opponent Summons a monster(s): Halve that monster(s)'s original ATK.

Super Rare.name: Ally of Justice Core Destroyer
Super Rare.desc: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles a LIGHT monster: Destroy that monster.

Super Rare.name: Beetron
Super Rare.desc: You can send 1 face-up Spell/Trap you control to the GY, then target 1 Level 4 or lower Insect monster in your GY; Special Summon that Insect monster in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Beetron" once per turn.

Super Rare.name: Enchanting Fitting Room
Super Rare.desc: Pay 800 LP; excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck and Special Summon all excavated Level 3 or lower Normal Monsters, also, after that, shuffle the rest back into your Deck.

Super Rare.name: Half Shut
Super Rare.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it cannot be destroyed by battle this turn, also its ATK is halved until the end of this turn.

Super Rare.name: Hyper Hammerhead
Super Rare.desc: At the end of the Damage Step, if an opponent's monster that battled this card is not destroyed: Return that opponent's monster to the hand.

Super Rare.name: Kabazauls
Super Rare.desc: A huge monster in the shape of a hippopotamus. The sneezing from his gigantic body is so fierce that people mistake it for a hurricane.

Super Rare.name: Man-Eater Bug
Super Rare.desc: FLIP: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

Super Rare.name: Ready for Intercepting
Super Rare.desc: Target 1 Warrior or Spellcaster monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position.

Super Rare.name: Slushy
Super Rare.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can send 1 "Slushy" from your Deck to the GY. If you have 3 copies of "Slushy" total, either banished and/or in your GY (combined): You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Level 5 or higher Sea Serpent monster in your GY; Special Summon that target. You can only use this effect of "Slushy" once per turn.

Super Rare.name: Summoner's Art
Super Rare.desc: Add 1 Level 5 or higher Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand.

Super Rare.name: The Legendary Fisherman
Super Rare.desc: While "Umi" is on the field, this card is unaffected by Spell effects and cannot be targeted for attacks, but does not prevent your opponent from attacking you directly.

Ultra Rare.name: Amazoness Swords Woman
Ultra Rare.desc: Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving this card instead.

Ultra Rare.name: Barrel Dragon
Ultra Rare.desc: Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; toss a coin 3 times and destroy it if at least 2 of the results are heads.

Ultra Rare.name: Fortress Whale
Ultra Rare.desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Fortress Whale's Oath".

Ultra Rare.name: King of the Skull Servants
Ultra Rare.desc: The original ATK of this card is the combined number of "King of the Skull Servants" and "Skull Servant" in your GY x 1000. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can banish 1 other "King of the Skull Servants" or 1 "Skull Servant" from your GY; Special Summon this card.

Ultra Rare.name: Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth
Ultra Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Petit Moth" on your 6th turn or later after it was equipped with "Cocoon of Evolution".

Ultra Rare.name: Serpent Night Dragon
Ultra Rare.desc: A dragon created from the soul of a wicked knight.
